description: On the table there’s an open black case with a foam insert, a small rubber duck in front of it, and a long gray remote-like device nearby. The right hand picks up the gray device and moves it toward the open case, then reaches into the case to lift one of the small white round items and places it back into a slot; next the right hand lowers the lid while the left hand steadies the case, and both hands press it closed before releasing.
